headline: Approved new construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street, where a building burned down.
summary: The design changed after earlier comments. The roof railing was set back from the street, and a fence was added between properties. A temporary vice chair was also elected because the chair was absent.
decisions: Elected a temporary vice chair for the evening, with five yes votes.
Recommended that the commission support the Harvey Grimage National Register nomination, 5-0, as reported from the October 21 meeting.
Approved new construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street, with all five members in favor.
discussion: Building scale on the hill: Members said newer homes are larger than the historic pattern, with less green space, though zoning allows the height and lot coverage.
Design changes: Members said the revisions, such as setting back the roof railing and adding a bump-out, helped the building fit the neighborhood.
Trim and siding details: Members asked about the base panels, the trim cap, and the depth of the bay on Gilbert Lane.

decision_evidence.quote: Okay, roll call. Yes, Madam Chair Pro Tem, Hillary Bassett, Cesar Cardi. Yes. Michael Hutchins. Yes. Rob Witten. Yes. Valerie Pinkle. Yes. The election is carried.
Nomination for the Harvey Grimage, the board voted five in favor, none opposed to recommend that the main historic preservation commission support the nomination.

Yes, I move to approve application HP 00892026 for new construction at 43 St. Lawrence Street on the basis of submitted documentation, plans, and specifications, information provided in the staff memo, and the attached findings by the historic preservation board as written that the project meets subsection 16.6.4 standards for review of additions and new construction. ... Motion carries.
